parsed_json.up: Select approved drugs with hypertension indication. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Join compound_structures on molregno for canonical SMILES. Filter where max_phase_for_ind equals 4 and mesh_heading equals 'hypertension'. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, EFO ID as indication_curie, mesh_heading as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
